channel.description: Stay updated on the latest news and events happening in the RPI community.

item.title: Smoothie Socials
item.description: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM - The Office of Alumni Engagement invites all students to join us for RPI Smoothie Socials, your monthly midweek pick-me-up! Enjoy delicious smoothies and snacks, connect with fellow students and select staff members, and get to know the Alumni Engagement team. Each month features a fun theme and a unique giveaway for the first 50 students through the door! September’s theme - Welcome Whirl; Giveaway - RPI blender bottle; Featured flavor -…

item.title: Drop-in Counseling Hours for Fall 2026
item.description: The RPI Counseling Center invites students to meet with a counselor without a formal appointment, during designated drop-in hours. There are drop-in hours available every weekday when classes are in session. Academy Hall Suite 4200.
item.author: Students

item.title: Study Abroad Information Session
item.description: Study Abroad - It’s Not Too Early to Start Planning for the Experience of a Lifetime! Thinking about studying abroad? Learn from a panel of RPI returnees, international exchange students, and Education Abroad staff. Wednesday, September 16, Bruggeman Room, CBIS, 12:30-1:30. This event is part of the FYE Beyond Blocks series.

item.title: Sheer Idiocy Comedy Improv Show
item.description: Date: Friday, September 18, 2026 8:00 PM - 10:00 PM - Sheer Idiocy Comedy Improv will be hosting a show in the Union Theater. Come join and enjoy a great evening show. For more detail reach out to farmeg3@rpi.edu.
item.author: Community

item.title: Intellectual Property and Technology Licensing (IPTL) Informational Session | Septermber 16 at 11:00 am
item.description: Are you working on groundbreaking research? Are you curious about what happens to your ideas, inventions, research, and software at RPI? Join the Intellectual Property & Technology Licensing (IPTL) team for an informational session on the basics of intellectual property. We’ll cover patents, copyrights, invention disclosures, commercialization, and when you should contact IPTL. Join Us on Wednesday September 16th at 11:00am. Online event. Registration required.

item.title: Ask Us Anything: Women in MANE
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 11:30 AM - 2:30 PM - Join the Ask me Anything event with Women in Mane including groups WIN, AIAA, WiME on the Playhouse Concourse to gather more information on these clubs. Please reach out to Crockm@rpi.edu for further information on the event.

item.title: Vision in Action Award — Great things happen when teams work together
item.description: Most times the biggest wins at RPI aren’t the work of one person—they’re the result of people from different areas coming together around a shared goal. Do you know a cross-functional team that has turned collaboration into meaningful results for RPI?

item.description: Date: Friday, September 18, 2026 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM - Schedule a confidential consultation to help you become better informed and more confident about your workplace retirement savings plan benefits. To schedule an appointment, call 1-800-642-7131, Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to midnight, or online at https://nb.fidelity.com/public/nbpreloginnav/rpi/microsite/#/tem/meet-with-us

item.title: RPI Faculty and Staff In-Person Workshop: Talk Smart, Teach Strong: Sharpening Your Academic Presentation Skills
item.description:
Date: Wednesday, September 30, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM - This session aims to strengthen academic presentation and facilitation skills, combining elements of presentation best practices with effective teaching strategies. You will explore techniques to enhance voice, presence, and impact in the classroom, while also engaging in train-the-trainer methods to foster active student participation. Please register by 9/25 using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
